description: Co-located evaluation tests for Copy & Messaging Specialist trigger resolution, two-track workflow, no invented metrics and list punctuation

test_cases.name: Copy & Messaging Specialist Trigger
test_cases.prompt: Audit and refine our onboarding modal copy and error messages for tone of voice consistency.

test_cases.name: Humanize AI-sounding Landing Copy
test_cases.description: Routes requests to de-AI or humanize landing/marketing copy to agent-copy.
test_cases.prompt: The website and content looks very much AI generated. Can we humanize the landing page copy and make it more human-centric? Mostly tweaks.

forbidden_patterns: Ship AI agents you can prove

test_cases.name: Sounds-AI Marketing Pass
test_cases.description: Marketing and AI-generated copy audits activate agent-copy.
test_cases.prompt: This marketing copy sounds AI-written. Tighten the brand voice and strip slogan padding.

test_cases.name: Write Copy For Hero And CTA
test_cases.description: Net-new landing write requests route to agent-copy.
test_cases.prompt: Write copy for the landing hero section and the primary CTA.

test_cases.name: Generic Corporate Copy Review
test_cases.prompt: This copy feels generic. Make this sound less corporate without a redesign.

test_cases.name: Do Not Invent Metrics
test_cases.description: Skill body forbids invented numbers and requires explicit placeholders.
test_cases.prompt: Rewrite copy for the feature description. We do not have a deploy-time metric yet.

test_cases.name: Oxford Comma Default Off
test_cases.description: Requests to cut serial/Oxford commas route to agent-copy and the skill forbids bulk , and replace.
test_cases.prompt: The docs overuse the Oxford comma. Tighten the landing page copy and drop habitual serial commas.
